items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I met with Georgie Stall and Alex Hyatt, his name was -- it's funny how all these names are coming to me -- he was head of the music department.

ctx.x: Johnny couldn't do it because he couldn't teach Mickey, you know, and he had to play this whole thing. There was a great drummer on the staff over at Fox -- Twentieth Century Fox -- because that was when they had staff musicians, you know, and at this point I was not a staff musician, you know, I was just a freelance musician, and well, they tried him -- Dela Nova or something like that, an odd name.

But Georgie Stall used to come -- where I was playing; he had heard me, you know, Georgie Stall was kind of a jazz buff, and he made all of the rounds. And so he called me and told me I should come out and see if I couldn't get the gig, and so I went out to MGM the next day, and he met me at the gate, and they asked me -- I have to be honest -- I was really cocky at this point, you know, I was real cocky, because you know, I thought that I could just play anything, and I met with Georgie Stall and Alex Hyatt, his…
